name: PT Kian Santang Muliatama Tbk
summary: PT Kian Santang Muliatama Tbk engages in the supply of spare parts to gas industry in Indonesia. It operates in two segments, Trading, and Constructions Service and Others. It offers gas meters, converter kits, regulators, transition fitting, meter regulating stations, and regulating stations under the RMG, Tormene, Canalta, Honeywell, Dunyun, Ergas, Sejin Valve, and Rucika brands. The company also provides supporting services to the gas industry; and engineering, procurement, and construction services, including design and engineering, site installation, and testing and commissioning services, as well as infrastructure and fabrication works.
